## GATEWAYGUARD — WHO DOES WHAT

Companion to the CPM Schedule (Rev 5, 24-Jul-2026)
Dated: 2026-07-24 08:46 EDT
38 calendar days to launch (September 1, 2026)

### 1. The Critical Path — In Plain English

These are the things that, if they slip, push the whole launch back. Everything else has breathing room. Guard these five with your life:
1. The 12 remaining guide pages. The tool links directly to these — no pages, no launch. Zero slack. Start today, 2–3 per session with Claude.
2. The code-signing certificate. The token is assigned but validation is still pending. Nothing gets signed until it clears. Follow up with SignMyCode if it's quiet by Monday.
3. ascii34 → field test → final fix. The build has to be stable and tested on all three machines before it can be signed. This is the longest chain.
4. The EULA attorney review. Call 1 is Monday. Signing the build waits on the license being settled (at least through the refund-policy call).
5. Signing → screenshots → site QA → launch. Once the build is signed, screenshots must match it, the site gets its final QA, and the hash goes live. This is the home stretch and it's all critical.
